data.source: HaluBench (https://huggingface.co/datasets/PatronusAI/HaluBench), built from FinanceBench/DROP/CovidQA/PubMedQA/HaluEval/RAGTruth; code on GitHub (patronus-ai/Lynx-hallucination-detection)

notes: GPT-4-Turbo is a straightforward zero-shot PASS/FAIL faithfulness classifier baseline compared against the proposed LYNX model on the public HaluBench benchmark. FinanceBench (1000 samples, 500 hallucinated) is the cleanest single-cell claim, but every column in Table 3 (HaluEval, RAGTruth, DROP, CovidQA, PubMedQA, Overall) is reproducible with the same printed evaluation prompt.
